summary: Ingest native_american tradition: Mooney Myths of the Cherokee + Eastman The Soul of the Indian

resolution.note: Native American tradition ingest complete: Mooney Myths of the Cherokee (220 chunks, myths section only, Sacred Formulas excluded on cultural-sensitivity grounds) + Eastman The Soul of the Indian (29 chunks). Full pipeline: manifest/acquire/chunk/clean, bootstrap, embed, tag (1548 judged, 682 applied), edges (277 judged, 62 PARALLELS + 1 CONTRASTS applied), dossiers campaign c6 (promoted + embedded), corpus v50 exported and loaded to docker postgres. New taxonomy concepts: oral_tradition, trickster_mythology.
